# Attribution — vendored external audit skills

These methodology files are vendored from open-source Claude/AI audit skill repos
so AuditFlow ships a self-contained, deployable engine. Each retains its origin's
license (MIT / Apache-2.0 as published). AuditFlow replaces their orchestration with
its own router + OpenCode Zen engine; the security knowledge is the original authors'.

| Prefix | Source |
|---|---|
| qs-* | quillai-network/qs_skills |
| nemesis* | 0xiehnnkta/nemesis-auditor |
| forefy-* | forefy/.context |
| sc-auditor | Archethect/sc-auditor |
| cdsecurity | CDSecurity/cdsecurity-skills |
| web3-client-auditor | DarkNavySecurity/web3-skills |
| scv-scan | kadenzipfel/scv-scan |
| solidityguard | alt-research/SolidityGuard |
| zeroskills | zerocoolailabs/ZeroSkills |
| solidity-ai-auditor | KannAILabs/Solidity-AI-security-auditor |
| bb-web3-audit | shuvonsec/claude-bug-bounty |
